defect: The historical run_seed + scenario-offset arithmetic re-used identical integer seeds for island replicate r and mainland replicate r+10, violating the intended independence of scenario-by-replicate Monte Carlo streams.
reporting_rule: Use the six-seed ensemble median and range for paper-facing baseline magnitudes. Retain the historical 20260826 draw only as provenance and deterministic implementation regression, not as the robustness headline.
rank_crossover_rule: Retain the existing decision rule: median starting-position share must increase monotonically, median community-realization share must decrease monotonically, and starting-position share must exceed community-realization share at k=16 in at least 5 of 6 seeds.
provenance_boundary: This correction changes random-stream construction only. It does not retune biological parameters, select favorable master seeds, or alter the declared trait grid, replicate count, or k sequence.
